name: CodeBlock
usage: Schemas and examples in API documentation, command-line examples, log excerpts

props.name: code
props.description: Code text; convert objects with `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` first.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height step: `sm` 160 px, `md` 320 px, `lg` 560 px; `none` for no limit.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines (by default they scroll horizontally).

props.name: copyable
props.description:
Shows a copy button (CopyButton) in the top right corner that copies `code`. The code leaves room for the
button, so the button does not cover the end of the first lines.

props.name: language
props.description:
Name of the language, such as `ts` or `json`, shown in a header row above the code (with the copy button
of `copyable` on the right). It is only a label: the code is not highlighted.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Showing JSON: format it as indented text first.

examples.name: Wrapped
examples.title: Commands and long lines
examples.description: Use `wrap` for command-line examples so that long lines wrap.

examples.name: Copyable
examples.title: Copy button
examples.description: `copyable` adds a copy button in the top right corner; it stays in place while the code scrolls.

examples.name: Language
examples.title: Language
examples.description:
`language` shows the language in a header row above the code, together with the copy button. The code is not
highlighted.
